content.summary: Research findings for tool bridging between OpenCode, Claude Agent SDK, and Vercel AI SDK

data.original_input: Map OpenCode tool bridging architecture (tool-bridge.ts, translate-*.ts, ToolRegistry), identify where Vercel AI SDK manages tool calls, and pinpoint display breakage points.

codebase_findings.note: Core tool definition via Tool.define with zod validation, truncation, and Tool.Context metadata/ask hooks. Tool outputs are {title, metadata, output, attachments?}.

ToolRegistry builds the tool list: built-ins + custom tools from config directories + plugin tools. ToolRegistry.tools() filters by model/provider and returns initialized tools with zod parameters and execute handlers.

SessionPrompt.resolveTools maps ToolRegistry tools into Vercel AI SDK tool definitions using ai.tool/jsonSchema. MCP tools are also wrapped here. This is the primary Vercel AI SDK tool management entry point.

LLM.stream uses streamText from the Vercel AI SDK. It passes tools + activeTools and handles experimental_repairToolCall; providerExecuted tool calls are remapped to a _providerExecuted stub. This is where Vercel AI SDK intercepts tool execution and validation.

createOpenCodeToolsServer builds an MCP server for Claude Agent SDK using ToolRegistry + MCP tools. It converts zod -> JSON schema -> zod raw shape, excludes SDK_NATIVE_TOOLS (read/write/edit/bash/glob/grep/ls), and wires permission/metadata hooks.
ClaudeAgentSDKLanguageModel creates the MCP server (tool-bridge) and calls Claude Agent SDK query with permissionMode=bypassPermissions, includePartialMessages, and disallowedTools list.
translateToSDKPrompt converts Vercel AI SDK prompt into Claude Agent SDK prompt, including tool results as tool_result messages with tool_use_id.

createSDKStreamTransformer maps Claude SDK events to Vercel AI SDK stream parts. It emits tool-input-start, tool-call, and tool-result with providerExecuted=true. tool_use_summary produces synthetic tool output (summary/placeholder), not full tool output content.
SessionProcessor consumes tool-input-start/tool-call/tool-result to maintain MessageV2.ToolPart state; display depends on these events and matching toolCallId.
MessageV2.toModelMessages renders tool parts into UI tool output. Pending/running tools are converted to output-error to avoid dangling tool_use blocks.
ProviderTransform.message normalizes toolCallId for Claude/Anthropic by replacing non-alphanumeric characters; this can affect toolCallId matching if upstream IDs differ.

patterns: Dual tool-definition pipeline: ToolRegistry -> Vercel AI SDK tools (SessionPrompt.resolveTools) AND ToolRegistry -> Claude Agent SDK MCP server (tool-bridge).
Claude Agent SDK executes tools via MCP (providerExecuted=true) while Vercel AI SDK still owns the tool execution pipeline via streamText and tools/activeTools.
SDK-native tools (read/write/edit/bash/glob/grep/ls) are excluded from MCP tool-bridge, so Claude SDK uses its own native tools; OpenCode sees only summary events in translate-stream.
Tool result display relies on tool-call/tool-result parts; translate-stream synthesizes results from tool_use_summary with minimal output, which can be lossy for UI display.
raw_options: Instrument the tool-call pipeline (translate-stream -> SessionProcessor) to trace tool_use_id/toolCallId/name mismatches and providerExecuted handling.
Bypass Vercel AI SDK tool execution when using Claude Agent SDK (omit tools/activeTools or use a direct stream path) so only MCP handles tools.
Keep Vercel AI SDK but add tool stubs per Claude tool name to avoid experimental_repairToolCall mapping to _providerExecuted (preserve display names).
Extend translate-stream to emit full tool output when available, or request richer tool result events from Claude SDK if supported.
Unify tool definitions by exposing only the MCP tool server to Claude SDK and removing duplicate tool schema conversions for SDK-native tools.
